4. **P2 — The HTTP error helper retains response bodies under `message`.**  
   [http.ex:135](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/provider/http.ex:135) returns the complete body map when it has no `"message"` field. The helper stores that map in `details.message`. Body summarization removes `details.body`, but leaves this copy. A response with `%{"content" => "private-body-marker"}` retained the content in the public error. Multiple provider transports use this helper.  
   **Correction:** Use a fixed fallback message. Accept an explicit message only when it has the expected scalar type. Keep other response content in the body summary.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.
title: The HTTP error helper retains response bodies under `message`
